palette.notes: Code: 25 colours, 3 short ramps (len 4) with almost no hue shift (0.4 deg). Black-red background pattern, saturated red hair, mint-teal outfit as complement.

lighting: Flat, graphic; no light direction. Contrast comes from complementary red against mint and from dark outlines.
silhouette: Front-facing OC with gas mask, red dreadlocks and nurse cap; big hair mass frames the head. Repeated copies of the figure fill the frame.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 19.38 drawings/s, on ones: the motion is After Effects transforms (scale, slide, duplicate) on a still drawing, not hand-drawn frames.

texture: Clean pixels at full canvas; ornamental damask-like pattern in the background; a pixel font for lyric captions.
camera: Animation-meme edit: zooms on the face, mirrored and tiled copies, slides, lyric-text cards, radial red burst, cut to end card around 17.5 s (ignored).

acting.enters: Face fills the frame in a tight close-up at 0 s.
acting.acts: One static pose is duplicated, mirrored and slid in time with the song; lyric words appear between.
acting.exits: Collapses to a logo on the radial burst background.
acting.depth: Layers copies at different scales over the pattern; no real depth, flat collage.

techniques: one drawing reused via scale, mirror and tile
lyric text cards in a pixel font between shots
radial burst background for the finale
cuts and slides on the beat
feel: red-on-black pattern + mint OC + one pose mirrored and slid on the beat = loud meme edit from a single drawing
for_fred: Avoid building a whole reel from one pose moved around (it is what made the last reel feel overused). Borrow only the beat-synced mirror/tile as a one-off punctuation, then go back to Fred acting with real poses.
